chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 260: The Qiongqi Puppets Attack — First Blood in the Immortal Estate
chapter_meta_description: The frost arrow formation grinds the party down, but when eighteen Primal-level Qiongqi puppets emerge, Buyou the Realperson becomes the first casualty of the Immortal estate’s true trap.
og_description: The frost arrow siege was just the warm-up. When Primal-level Qiongqi puppets crash the party, someone dies in seconds.
twitter_description: The Immortal estate stops playing nice. Eighteen Qiongqi puppets swarm the group and Buyou the Realperson doesn’t make it out.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese mythology, one of the Four Perils (四凶)—a winged tiger-ox hybrid that devours humans and represents chaos. In this chapter, they appear as Primal-level combat puppets in the Immortal estate’s formation.
A standard joint-attack formation taught to all disciples of the Black-White College, using five cultivators each aligned with one elemental phase to amplify collective defense and power.
A Fiendgod born in the Primordial Fiendgod Era, currently at the Primal Daoist level; a true grandmaster of formations and Shaoyan Nong’s personal bodyguard, who was separated from the group.
A Wanxiang Adept serving as part of Shaoyan Nong’s expedition team; the first member of the party to die in the Immortal estate’s trap.
Magical constructs hardened to the toughness of magic treasures and possessing combat power equivalent to Primal Daoists, making them both expensive and extremely difficult to destroy.
